description: This file defines the AppContext class which manages application state, synchronization, challenges, and user interactions within a note-taking app, including methods for signing in, signing out, syncing, handling challenges, and managing notes.

classes.name: AppContext
classes.description: A class managing application lifecycle, synchronization, challenges, and user interactions in a note-taking app.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes AppContext with optional parameters like identifier, crypto, email, password, passcode, host.

methods.name: enableLogging
methods.description: Enables logging for syncService and payloadManager.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates the application instance asynchronously.

methods.name: ignoreChallenges
methods.description: Sets flag to ignore challenges.

methods.name: resumeChallenges
methods.description: Resumes challenge handling.

methods.name: disableIntegrityAutoHeal
methods.description: Disables auto-healing of integrity issues.

methods.name: disableKeyRecovery
methods.description: Disables key recovery process.

methods.name: handleChallenge
methods.description: Handles challenges by responding based on prompts.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in the user with stored email and password.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with stored email and password.

methods.name: receiveServerResponse
methods.description: Processes server response with retrieved items.

methods.name: resolveWhenKeyRecovered
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when a specific key is recovered.

methods.name: awaitSignInEvent
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves on sign-in or registration event.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Deinitializes and reinitializes the application.

methods.name: signout
methods.description: Signs out the user and reinitializes the app.

methods.name: syncWithIntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs sync with integrity check enabled.

methods.name: awaitNextSucessfulSync
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves after a successful sync.

methods.name: awaitNextSyncEvent
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves on a specific sync event.

methods.name: awaitUserPrefsSingletonCreation
methods.description: Waits until user preferences singleton is created.

methods.name: awaitUserPrefsSingletonResolution
methods.description: Waits until user preferences are updated.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Prepares and launches the application.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the application.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization with optional parameters.

methods.name: maximumSync
methods.description: Performs a maximum sync with predefined options.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Changes user password.

methods.name: findItem
methods.description: Finds an item by UUID.

methods.name: findPayload
methods.description: Finds a payload by UUID.

methods.name: itemsKeys
methods.description: Gets displayable item keys.

methods.name: disableSyncingOfItems
methods.description: Disables syncing for specific item UUIDs.

methods.name: disableKeyRecoveryServerSignIn
methods.description: Stubs out server sign-in for key recovery.

methods.name: preventKeyRecoveryOfKeys
methods.description: Prevents recovery of specific keys.

methods.name: respondToAccountPasswordChallengeWith
methods.description: Sets password for account password challenges.

methods.name: spyOnChangedItems
methods.description: Adds observer callback for changed items.

methods.name: createSyncedNote
methods.description: Creates a note, syncs, and returns the note object.

methods.name: deleteItemAndSync
methods.description: Deletes an item and syncs.

methods.name: changeNoteTitle
methods.description: Changes the title of a note.

methods.name: changeNoteTitleAndSync
methods.description: Changes note title and syncs.

methods.name: findNoteByTitle
methods.description: Finds a note by its title.

methods.name: noteCount
methods.description: Returns the count of displayable notes.

methods.name: createConflictedNotes
methods.description: Creates conflicting notes in two contexts.
